43. 某戲劇學會由 12 名男生及 8 名女生組成。若從該學會中選出 5 名學生為一隊參加比賽且該隊至少有一名女生,則可組成多少不同的隊?
A. 3960
B. 14 712
C. 15 448
D. 15 504
reasoning: Total students = 12 (boys) + 8 (girls) = 20. Total ways to choose 5 students = C(20, 5) = 15504. Ways to choose 5 students with NO girls (only boys) = C(12, 5) = 792. Ways to choose at least one girl = Total ways - Ways with only boys = 15504 - 792 = 14712.
